repair.broken: He eat too much fast food after school.

errors.explanation: Use -s with he/she/it in the present simple.

a: He eats too much fast food after school.

repair.broken: He plays too much video games at night.

errors.explanation: Use too many with countable plural nouns.

a: He plays too many video games at night.

repair.broken: She has too many homework this week.

errors.explanation: Use too much with uncountable nouns like homework.

a: She has too much homework this week.

repair.broken: He get enough sleep on school nights.

errors.explanation: Use -s with he/she/it in the present simple.

a: He gets enough sleep on school nights.

repair.broken: She eats lots of vegetable with dinner.

errors.explanation: Use the plural form after lots of when you mean many countable things.

a: She eats lots of vegetables with dinner.

repair.broken: You should to do regular exercise.

errors.explanation: Use should + base verb, not should to.

transform.broken: He plays too many video games.
a: He should play fewer video games.
transform.explanation: Use should + base verb to give advice.
